name: Species Card
summary: A card that identifies one species and expands to show its details.
description: A species identity card that sits in a row of others, showing a title and image at rest and expanding in place to reveal measurements, conservation status, and a caption. Where it sits in the row changes its own corners, so a run of cards reads as one connected shape rather than separate tiles with gaps between them.
whenToUse: Introducing a species in a row where several cards sit edge to edge
Letting someone select a card to see its measurements and status without leaving the row
whenNotToUse: Showing video or audio content — use a Media Card instead
Displaying a single species with no row of neighbors — a plain image and title may not need this card's corner-fusing behavior

position.standalone: Not part of a row. Square corners on every side.
position.row-left: The leftmost card in a connected row. Only its outer edge rounds.
position.row-middle: A middle card in a row. Flat on both sides where neighbors touch.
position.row-middle-raised: A middle card set slightly forward from its row.
position.row-right: The rightmost card in a connected row. Only its outer edge rounds.

state.collapsed: Shows the title, description, and image only.
state.expanded: Adds measurements, status, and a caption above the image, for the one card that's selected.

states.hover: Fill lightens slightly to invite a click.
states.focus: Same lightened fill as hover, for keyboard focus.
states.press: Fill lightens further than hover, for the instant of activation.

dos: Keep a card's corners consistent with its position in the row.
Reserve the expanded state for the one card that's selected.
Pass a real image whenever one exists, even for the collapsed card.
donts: Don't expect a new row arrangement without adding its own position value.
Don't treat the illustration as swappable through a component slot. Replace its fill directly.

accessibility.role: button, when the card is selectable
keyboard: Enter / Space toggles the expanded state
notes: Give it a visible title so its accessible name comes from real text rather than nothing at all.
